title: Chapter 113
text:
Bennett touched his cheek that was punched and said helplessly, "Don't hit my face."

Are you satisfied?

Han Xiao silently glanced at Bennett's lower body.

Bennett suddenly felt as if a cold wind blew between his legs. He shivered and wondered, Am I hallucinating?

Most of Bennett's data was unknown, but Han Xiao knew that Bennett had more than 15 talents, and a few of them were Molding Talents! The scariest talent was not those that added attributes, attack, or HP, but the [Lucky Aura]. The description was ambiguous, but it could be immediately known how terrifying it was.

Protagonist Aura!

The universe was extremely vast, and different planets and civilizations would give birth to one in a million heroes and epics. Having the Lucky Aura was the standard template of a protagonist.

For example, if Bennett used [Flaming Will], he would receive the highest number of bonuses every time. This was the ability of the Lucky Aura.

But he's actually in a state of internal injury now. He should be able to recover in the future. Han Xiao remembered that when Bennett first appeared in front of the players, he was full of energy. He was like a human-shaped Tyrannosaurus.

Bennett was Grade C at his peak, and now he was Grade D +.

Grade C's standard Energy Rank was 2,000, and Grade D + meant that one's combat power was at least 1,600, which was still very strong.

Han Xiao's current combat power was stuck at around 800 Grade D, and with the bonus of his equipment, he officially reached Grade D. Grade could not fully reflect combat power. After all, different abilities had their advantages and disadvantages in various environments. However, as long as one's Energy Rank was high, it meant that one was at least very good at a certain aspect.

After bidding farewell to Bennett, Han Xiao returned to his sniping post. Suddenly, he felt something and turned around. A female sniper was staring at him. Han Xiao had an impression of this woman. She seemed to be called Golden Fox, a newcomer who had just arrived the day before yesterday.

Han Xiao touched his face and confirmed that he was wearing the Facial Simulator. He was puzzled. This doesn't make sense. Could it be that she was attracted by my handsomeness through the mask?

Golden Fox moved closer to Black Panther with a charming smile on her face. She smiled and asked, "Mr. Black, I wonder if you have the time to teach me sniping techniques."

As she spoke, the Golden Fox intentionally or unintentionally squeezed her breasts with the inner side of her arm, squeezing out a deep curve of her chest.

Is she trying to seduce me? Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. No matter what the Golden Fox was up to, he was not going to fall for it. He raised his hand in front of him and said seriously, "Miss, please behave yourself!"

The Golden Fox's eyes flashed. She realized that Mr. Hei had a high resistance to lust, so she immediately changed her expression. She put away her charm and put on a pitiful look. Her expression changed faster than a Sichuan opera. She crossed her arms in front of her chest and said weakly, "I … I just want to ask for your advice. I don't mean anything else."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. "Little girl, don't waste your energy. I don't like women."

The Golden Fox's face froze. She looked at Han Xiao in shock and stuttered, "Could it be that you …"

"No, I don't like men either." Han Xiao rubbed his chin and said, "Actually, I'm not even interested in humans. Hmm … living things are boring."

The Golden Fox was shocked. She lowered her head in panic and said, "I'm … I'm sorry."

She then turned around and ran without hesitation.

Han Xiao chuckled. "You want to use a honey trap on me? You're too inexperienced. Back in the day, I was also an impressive young man. I was just a fleeting beauty."

After laughing to himself for a while, Han Xiao suddenly stopped. He let out a long sigh, took out a cigarette from his pocket, and started smoking.

At this time, a car approached the manor. Han Xiao looked out and was shocked.

The car was completely black. There was an emblem on the door of the car. It was a dragon circling three stars.

It was the car of Division 13!

"Why are the people from Division 13 here?"

…

The mercenaries guarding the gate received Wang Yuan's instructions and opened the gate, allowing Division 13 to drive the car into the manor.

Her legs, which were wrapped in a tight combat uniform, stepped out of the car. She was petite but had a beautiful curve. She attracted the attention of many mercenaries. The first person to step out of the car was Han Xiao's acquaintance, Di Su Su.

At this time, Di Su Su had an indifferent look on her face. Her team members were following behind her.

The group of boorish mercenaries around them whistled at her and sized up Di Su Su's figure without any scruples.

A middle-aged man with wrinkles at the corner of his eyes walked out of the car. Di Su Su and the rest of the agents followed him and walked into the villa.

Di Su Su suddenly felt a prickling sensation in her back, and a chill gushed out from her heart. She knew that she was being targeted by an extremely dangerous person. She immediately turned around and saw a middle-aged man in black holding a sniper rifle leaning against the wall, staring at her. His gaze was calm, but it made her involuntarily tense up. She felt a chill in her heart, and she felt a sense of danger.

"Who is this person?" Di Su Su suddenly felt a sense of familiarity. However, she did not have time to think about it. She walked into the villa and closed the door.

Beside the wall, Han Xiao looked at the backs of the agents from Division 13.

…

The agents from Division 13 went straight to the top floor of the villa. Wang Yuan and Bennett were waiting there.

"Wang Yuan, long time no see." The leader of Division 13 spoke. His face was expressionless, but his tone was as if he was meeting an old friend.

"Mo Ran." Wang Yuan nodded. "It has been at least ten years. You are one of the trump cards of Division 13, and I am the leader of the Dark Net. If not for this incident, we might not have the chance to meet again."

"Yes." Mo Ran nodded. He saw Bennett beside him. Although his face was still expressionless, his tone was surprised. "You are here too?"

Bennett said unhappily, "Do you still want to challenge me? I have no interest in winning against you again. "

"Humph, let's not talk about the past." Mo Ran stopped this topic.

"Bennett?" Di Su Su and the rest were shocked. Bennett's name was well-known in all intelligence agencies. Not only was he a hero during the war, but he was also one of the top three most dangerous targets because of his strong personal strength. Di Su Su could not help but feel nervous.

Mo Ran frowned and asked, "There have been battles here for more than ten days. Although it is outside the city, it has caused a bad influence. The sound of gunfire is too obvious. What are you guys doing?"

Wang Yuan shook his head. "We, the elders of the Dark Net, have always insisted on being neutral. However, power and influence are accompanied by greed. Some of the ambitious higher-ups see us, the 'stubborn' leaders, as obstacles in their way. They are eyeing our positions and want to replace us to control this huge force. These attackers were hired by the traitors. Xena is tracking these traitors through clues. Most of them have been eliminated. The traitors will make their final counterattack in the next two days. "

"Then come to Seagull City in two days. We will catch up," Mo Ran said. With Bennett around, he was not worried about Wang Yuan's safety.

After they finished talking, Mo Ran turned around and left. Di Su Su and the rest followed behind him.

The Secret Service Operations Department was the most powerful individual force in Division 13, but they were not the best. There was a small group of people who were the secret weapons of the country. They were usually in charge of guarding the branches and taking charge of the overall situation. They were rarely seen and were known as aces. Mo Ran was such a person. Every country had such people.

"Now is such an eventful time." Di Su Su sighed.

It seemed that Stardragon had been involved in a whirlpool since three months ago. First, it was the Germinal Organization base hidden in the territory. Then, it was the expedition to Dark Crow Valley. The source of the information was very mysterious.

Furthermore, the Germinal Organization's response was very strange. The spies seemed to be looking for someone. After the Dark Crow Valley operation, the spies of the Germinal Organization became even more fearless. It was as if they did not care about being exposed. They searched crazily throughout Stardragon. The situation in the West Capital was the worst. They had already captured hundreds of spies of the Germinal Organization under the Wind Eye, but they were all peripheral members. They could not get any valuable information from the interrogation.

Ever since Han Xiao disappeared, Division 13 had sent out a large number of agents to search for him, but to no avail. All the surveillance cameras, flight records, and entry and exit records could not find any clues. Even the agents sent to search the wilderness could not find any clues.

This result was unbelievable to the higher-ups of Division 13. Han Xiao seemed to have disappeared from the face of the earth.

Where did he go?

Where could he have gone?

What was he going to do?

Di Su Su had spent some time with Han Xiao before. In her eyes, Han Xiao was a mysterious person who was shrouded in mystery. She was also very curious about Han Xiao's whereabouts.

Walking out of the villa, Di Su Su subconsciously looked at the man in black who made her feel threatened. However, he was already gone.

The people of Division 13 got into the car and left the villa.
